svg.desc: Lasutriv. ROLE: Game developer · autonomous AI agents. LATEST: Monarchy · New Roots. ASSET: AIA-Evolve, an AI agent that ships code 24/7. An antique sea chart of an island with places named Monarchy, New Roots, AIA; a red dashed route runs from a wreck offshore to an X.
